settings.label: Claude Code settings.json passthrough (JSON)
settings.description: Raw Claude Code settings, deep-merged over the block Agento generates into .claude/settings.json (operator wins). Examples: {"permissions":{"deny":["WebSearch","WebFetch"]}} blocks the built-in web tools even under --dangerously-skip-permissions; {"advisorModel":"fable"} picks the /advisor model. Invalid JSON fails the workspace build. Never put a credential here: this value is stored unencrypted and is written into the agent container.
